episodes.title: Olek Drops a Dime
episodes.summary: Mr. Rabbit's number one guy Olek calls the prison where Hood is incarcerated and speaks with the Albino, urging him to befriend Hood and get Olek information on Ana's whereabouts. It is clear Olek has his own personal reasons for his actions.

episodes.title: A Thief, Not a Killer
episodes.summary: Dr. Paradis talks with Hood, trying to convince him that prison is changing him.

episodes.title: Carrie at the Gate
episodes.summary: A pregnant Carrie has second thoughts about visiting Hood in prison when thoughts of her father enter her mind.

episodes.title: Looking for My Exit
episodes.summary: Still at the prison, a phone call from her fiancee helps Carrie finally find her exit from Hood.

episodes.title: Sugar's Release
episodes.summary: Ten years ago, Sugar, newly released from prison, meets with Kai who tells him he can resume working for Kai's nefarious interests and also offers Sugar a place to stay.

episodes.title: The Forge
episodes.summary: Kai checks in on his friend Sugar, who has stopped going to his factory job and is on the bottle. Sugar laments that no one will help him start his own buisness and Kai gets and idea.

episodes.title: Siobhan Interrupted
episodes.summary: Officer Yawners once again must intercede when his unemployed friend Siobhan causes problems at a bar because of her deteriorating marriage. Emmitt puts the idea into her head about becoming a cop herself.

episodes.title: Kings and Pawns
episodes.summary: Mr. Rabbit speaks with Olek about Hood's ten year imprisonment anniversary and gets misty eyed, his love for Hood obvious. Olek pointedly reminds Mr. Rabbit who he is.

episodes.title: Checking In
episodes.summary: Hood calls Job from prison, inquiring about Ana (Carrie now), his love for her undiminished and despondent that Ana never visited him. Job assures him she has moved on, disappearing with his help so that even Job doesn't know where she is. When the call ends, we learn a different story.

episodes.title: The Women
episodes.summary: A chance meeting between Siobhan and Rebecca reveals that both women have been living their own lies. Siobhan's decision to move on with her life puts the spark of an idea in Rebecca's mind.

episodes.title: Carrie and Deva
episodes.summary: Deva discovers a locket of Carrie's that sparks a memory of Hood for Carrie, and causes yet another confrontation between mother and daughter.

episodes.title: Passed Over
episodes.summary: Brock learns from the very young Mayor that Banshee is looking elsewhere for the new sheriff, mostly beacause of Brock's inability to do anything about Kai's illegal activities.

episodes.title: The Real Lucas Hood
episodes.summary: Newly hired Sheriff Lucas Hood arrives in Banshee and stops by Sugar's place for a beer and something to eat. While there, he telephones his estranged son to let him know where his current whereabouts.

episodes.title: Hotwire
episodes.summary: Seventeen years ago, Job teaches Hood how to hotwire a car. Job expresses his doubts about Hood becoming associated with Mr. Rabbit. When Job learns there is a girl involved (Ana), he is furious.

episodes.title: Allenwood, Part 1
episodes.summary: Seventeen years ago, inmate Sugar receives a visit from Kai Procter. We learn that Sugar is in prison for severely injuring Kai's attacker. Kai wants revenge for Sugar, a man he has known and cared about since childhood. Sugar urges Kai to let it go.

episodes.title: Interrogation, Part 1
episodes.summary: Fifteen years ago, Hood is questioned by police and the FBI after being captured at his last job. Hood is unknown to the authorities, but they suspect he has special forces training. As an interrogation tactic, the police provide proof to Hood that he was set up. Hood discovers who betrayed him.

episodes.title: Interrogation, Part 2
episodes.summary: The police pressure Hood, trying to get him to give up Mr. Rabbit for a reduced sentence. Hood finally gives in, and asks for something to eat.

episodes.title: Interrogation, Part 3
episodes.summary: Hood gets his food, but doesn't cooperate, having figured out the police interrogator's game.

episodes.title: The Phone Call
episodes.summary: We see the other side of the conversation highlighted in episode 1, season 1. This time we see the Albino in the prison yard, receiving his instructions from Olek to get close to Hood.
